answer: The purpose of the GOVERN function in the NIST AI RMF Core is to cultivate and implement a culture of risk management within organizations involved in AI systems. It outlines processes, documents, and organizational schemes to anticipate, identify, and manage risks associated with AI systems, including their impacts on users and society. The GOVERN function provides a structure for aligning AI risk management with organizational principles and policies, connects technical aspects of AI design to organizational values, and addresses the full product lifecycle and associated legal issues. It is a cross-cutting function that informs and is infused throughout the other functions of the AI risk management process.
